## Bio

I am a recent graduate from the [Modern Statistics and Statistical Machine Learning](https://statml.io) doctoral programme at the University of Oxford, supervised by Professor Christl Donnelly and Dr Kris V Parag.

Currently, I am working as a research consultant at [Verdel Instruments](https://verdelinstruments.com), where I am developing statistical and machine learning methods to analyse 2D mass spectrometry data. **I am open to other opportunities in the science start-up space.** Please reach out if you have an interesting problem that might benefit from my skills.

[My doctoral thesis](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:e045db75-76e4-440c-9103-30f24eac754b) focussed on robust statistical methods for analysing infectious disease dynamics with an emphasis on **uncertainty quantification**. Most recent work involved developing a theoretical/philosophical [decision-theoretic framework for uncertainty quantification](https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwag154) that is targeted to the practicalities of epidemiology, and [extending existing popular methods](https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwaf165) to improve the robustness of their UQ.

Further research from my thesis combines Bayesian inference, [sequential Monte Carlo methods](https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.70204) ([see also](http://nicsteyn2.github.io/SMCforRt/)), and epidemiological modelling, with applications to standard epidemiological data, as well as [survey data](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1013515) ([see also](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjph-2025-002851)) and [wastewater-based surveillance](https://www.nature.com/articles/s43856-024-00570-3) ([see also](https://github.com/nicsteyn2/NZWastewaterModelling)).

During my studies, I also worked as a research assistant in the [*The Global Reference Group for Children Affected by Crisis*](https://www.spi.ox.ac.uk/the-global-reference-group-on-children-affected-by-covid-19#collapse3701021), estimating [orphanhood in Brazil](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.lana.2025.101252) during the COVID-19 pandemic, and held a variety of tutoring positions (departmental, college, and inter-departmental courses).

Experience prior to my DPhil includes modelling for policymakers during the COVID-19 pandemic in my home country of New Zealand (March 2020 - September 2021), a quantitative trading internship at Optiver in Sydney (November 2019 - January 2020), and a data analysis internship at a startup in Bangkok (January - February 2018).
